name: Mongoose Bite spends its charges without an 8 second category lockout (#6568)
contract: Mongoose Bite 901004 is linked by SpellCharges.dbc to charge category 2: 3 charges with a 10 second recharge. Spell.dbc also gives it CategoryRecoveryTime 8000 and its tooltip names no cooldown, so the charges are the only intended limit. Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns kept applying the 8 second category cooldown after spending a charge, which blocked a second cast for 8 seconds. Two casts a global cooldown apart spend two charges.

steps.label: Let login hooks and spawn AI settle
DISCRIMINATING: a second cast a global cooldown later spends the next charge
